text:
Maya Ortiz: Pushing a new iteration of the Private setup wizard networking step. Main goals: make failures actionable, surface streaming preflight results, and clean up copy for non-network engineers. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678. Please drop UX/accessibility/dev notes. Devon Park: Nice direction. Two big asks: 1) show which checks are blocking vs advisory right on the stepper; 2) change 'Run preflight' -> 'Verify network' to be more discoverable. Also the stepper should include a tooltip explaining counts (e.g., 3 passed, 1 advisory, 2 failed). Ibrahim Noor: From infra side: the preflight runs five probes (DNS, NAT, TLS, egress IP, port reachability). Some customers have flaky DNS so the UI should allow re-running a single probe and not reset the whole suite. Also record the probe start/end times in logs. Claire Zhou: Accessibility: do not rely on color alone for statuses. Each row needs an explicit status label ('Passed', 'Warning', 'Failed') plus an icon. Add an aria-live region announcing status changes: e.g.,
NAT check failed
 Keyboard flow: after a failure, move focus to the failed item and open its details panel. ops-bot: deploy-notice: preflight-service v2.1 deployed to staging at 2026-02-12T09:12:00Z Devon Park: Copy tweaks for failure details: lead with a short 'why this matters' sentence, then actionable steps and a raw output toggle. Example: 'NAT blocked: the setup cannot reach Redwood model pools. To fix: enable outbound NAT or add egress rule X.' Keep the raw output collapsed by default. Ibrahim Noor: For engineers, include a 'Test endpoint with curl' snippet in details. Example: curl -v https://redwood.example.local/healthz Also add a copy-to-clipboard button for logs. Claire Zhou: Contrast issue: the yellow warning badge falls below 4.5:1 on 12px text. Recommend darker warning #B45309 or include a high-contrast outline. a11y-bot can run the color token checks. a11y-bot: automated-lint: badge--warning contrast-fail (ratio 3.1:1). suggested token #B45309. Maya Ortiz: Implementation notes I will add to the spec: streaming updates per-check with incremental toast-free updates, retry per probe, blocking vs advisory flags, focus movement rules, and a collapsed raw output panel with copy. Also add copy alternatives for PM to choose from. Will update Figma and post new frames in ~90m. Devon Park: One more UX request: when a user hovers the stepper, show a micro-summary panel with short remediation links (e.g., 'Fix NAT' -> open docs). Ibrahim Noor: Logging suggestion: include probe id + request id so support can correlate customer reports. Claire Zhou: I'll validate keyboard tab order and run a screen-reader pass once frames are posted. Maya Ortiz: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups: UX copy variants (PM to pick), a11y checklist, and infra logging ticket. Ping me for reviews.
